title: Finite lattice representation and undecidability

result.label: Finite lattice representation and undecidability
result.statement: Some finite lattices are not congruence lattices of any finite algebra, answering the finite lattice representation problem negatively. Moreover, no algorithm decides whether a finite lattice has such a representation, or whether it is a full subgroup interval of a finite group.
result.roleNote: The family's stated result in the release.
